decisions.reason: A safety shoe line is the firm's core competence, so in-house development and manufacturing knowledge let it interpret results and refine the line.
Comfort insoles are closely related to its footwear and foot-measurement expertise, though as one of several overlapping insoles it carries some consolidation risk.
Supportive insoles build directly on the firm's ergonomic and foot-measurement knowledge, so it can assimilate feedback, even if the insole range may be streamlined.
The ergonomic safety shoe series sits at the heart of its in-house R&D and has its own dedicated page, signalling strong commitment.
Firefighter boots extend its protective footwear know-how into a related niche that its development and production capabilities can absorb.
The moulded insole is featured on the home page and fits the firm's foot-measurement and tailored-solution capabilities.
